name: factlot
description: FactLot: an open fact layer for commercial real estate AI agents. Skills that call audited, deterministic calculators instead of doing CRE arithmetic in the model.

plugins.name: factlot
plugins.description: Twelve commercial real estate skills (loan sizing and amortization, lease economics, CAM reconciliation, ASC 842, lease vs own, returns, valuation and waterfalls, 1031 exchanges, multifamily rent rolls, hotel metrics, Texas protest deadline, Texas unequal-appraisal arithmetic) backed by the free hosted FactLot MCP server and its audited calculators.
